balance_of_justice.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：抽一张牌。仅当对手本回合抽过两张或更多牌时才能启动。
守御
balance_of_justice.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Draw a card. Activate this only if an opponent has drawn 2 or more cards this turn.
Guardwell

barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
淬炼
barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_en:
When this defends, if there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Temper

blizzard.text_zh: 目标攻击失去且不能获得再动，除非其操控者支付2点资源。
blizzard.text_en: Target attack loses and can't gain go again unless its controller pays {r}{r}.

boots_of_omnis_ward.text_zh:
若你本回合受到过秘法伤害，此牌获得+1防御。
瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。
淬炼
boots_of_omnis_ward.text_en:
If you've been dealt arcane damage this turn, this gets +1{d}.
Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Temper

boulder_drop.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，该英雄将手牌中的一张牌置于其牌库顶。
boulder_drop.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, they put a card from their hand on top of their deck.

channel_iceloch_glaze.text_zh:
再动
当对手控制霜咬衍生物或冻结的永久物时，其军械库中的牌处于冻结状态。
引导冰霜——在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个流动指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个流动指示物将一张冰牌从资源区置于牌库底，否则摧毁此牌。
channel_iceloch_glaze.text_en:
Go again
Cards in opponents' arsenals are frozen while they control a Frostbite or a frozen permanent.
Channel Ice - At the beginning of your end phase, put a flow counter on this, then destroy it unless you put an Ice card from your pitch zone on the bottom of your deck for each flow counter on it.

channel_lake_frigid.text_zh:
再动
牌和启动的异能对对手英雄而言额外消耗1点资源。
引导冰霜——在你的结束阶段开始时，在严寒湖上放置一个流动指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个流动指示物将一张冰牌从资源区置于牌库底，否则摧毁严寒湖。
channel_lake_frigid.text_en:
Go again
Cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes an additional {r}.
Channel Ice - At the beginning of your end phase, put a flow counter on Channel Lake Frigid then destroy it unless you put an Ice card from your pitch zone on the bottom of your deck for each flow counter on it.

colors_of_aria.text_zh: 当此牌正面朝上位于任何区域时，它同时具有大地、冰和闪电属性。
colors_of_aria.text_en: While this is face-up in any zone, it's Earth, Ice, and Lightning.

command_and_conquer.text_zh: 防御反应牌不能在此链环中使用。当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。
command_and_conquer.text_en: Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link. When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal.

crown_of_everbloom.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：将你军械库中的一张牌置于牌库底。若如此做，抽一张牌并创造一个法殁神盾衍生物。
秘法屏障2
crown_of_everbloom.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card and create a Spellbane Aegis token.
Arcane Barrier 2

crumble_to_eternity.text_zh:
贾尔专精
当此牌进入竞技场时，你可以在一个装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
crumble_to_eternity.text_en:
Jarl Specialization
When this enters the arena, you may put a -1{d} counter on an equipment.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then your next attack this turn gets dominate.

everbloom_life.text_zh:
融合
选择坟场中一张费用小于你本回合获得生命总量的行动牌，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。
再动
//
获得1点生命。

felling_of_the_crown.text_zh:
若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，此牌获得+4力量。
分解——当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，每位英雄将手牌中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
felling_of_the_crown.text_en:
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, this gets +4{p}.
Decompose - When this attacks, you may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, each hero puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck.

fiddlers_green.text_zh: 当此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，获得3点生命。
fiddlers_green.text_en: When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, gain 3{h}.

frozen_to_death.text_zh:
冰融合
若此牌已融合，你可以摧毁一个带有-1防御指示物的装备。
你可以在一个暴露的头部、胸部、手臂或腿部区域创造一个霜咬衍生物。
frozen_to_death.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If this was fused, you may destroy an equipment with a -1{d} counter.
You may create a Frostbite token in an exposed head, chest, arms, or legs zone.

fruits_of_the_forest.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：获得2点生命。

fyendals_spring_tunic.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，若此牌上的能量指示物少于3个，你可以在其上放置一个能量指示物。
瞬间——从此牌上移除3个能量指示物：获得1点资源。
刃碎

gauntlets_of_the_boreal_domain.type_zh: 大地·冰·守护者装备·手臂
gauntlets_of_the_boreal_domain.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：若以此方式弃置的是大地牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得+2力量；若是冰牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得支配。再动
淬炼
gauntlets_of_the_boreal_domain.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: If an Earth card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get +2{p} this turn. If an Ice card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get dominate this turn. Go again
Temper

heart_of_ice.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：本回合对手英雄使用的牌和启动的异能额外消耗1点资源。再动
秘法屏障1
刃碎
heart_of_ice.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes additional {r} this turn. Go again
Arcane Barrier 1
Blade Break

imposing_visage.text_zh:
从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用为X或更低的光环牌，将其置入竞技场，然后洗牌。
再动
imposing_visage.text_en:
Search your deck for an aura card with cost X or less, put it into the arena, then shuffle your deck.
Go again

mangle.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，摧毁该英雄控制的一个带有-1防御指示物的装备。
mangle.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, destroy target equipment they control with a -1{d} counter.

oaken_old.text_zh:
大地与冰融合
若老橡树已融合，它获得+2力量、支配，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄将手牌中的两张随机牌以任意顺序置于其牌库底。”
oaken_old.text_en:
Earth and Ice Fusion
If Oaken Old was fused, it gains +2{p}, dominate, and "If this hits a hero, they put 2 random cards from their hand on the bottom of their deck in any order."

plow_under.text_zh:
若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，此牌获得+4力量。
分解——当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，每位英雄将军械库中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
plow_under.text_en:
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, this gets +4{p}.
Decompose - When this attacks, you may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, each hero puts a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck.

pulse_of_isenloft.text_zh:
传奇
大地、冰和元素行动牌在本回合防御时获得+1防御。
pulse_of_isenloft.text_en:
Legendary
Earth, Ice, and Elemental action cards have +1{d} while defending this turn.

rampart_of_the_rams_head.text_zh: 每当你用公羊之首壁垒防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+1防御直到回合结束。
rampart_of_the_rams_head.text_en: Whenever you defend with Rampart of the Ram's Head, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +1{d} until end of turn.

ripple_away.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：如果本回合某个行动牌效果将创造一个或更多衍生物，则改为各创造数量减1的这些衍生物。
ripple_away.text_en: Instant - Discard this: If an action card effect would create 1 or more tokens this turn, instead it creates that many minus 1 of each of those tokens.

rootbound_carapace.text_zh: 分解——你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，此牌获得+1防御。
rootbound_carapace.text_en: Decompose - You may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{d}.

shelter_from_the_storm.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：本回合你接下来三次受到伤害时，每次防止其中1点伤害。
shelter_from_the_storm.text_en: Instant - Discard this: The next 3 times you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 1 of that damage.

sink_below.text_zh: 你可以将手牌中的一张牌置于牌库底。若如此做，抽一张牌。
sink_below.text_en: You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.

stalagmite_bastion_of_isenloft.text_zh:
每当你用石笋防御时，在攻击英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
淬炼
stalagmite_bastion_of_isenloft.text_en:
Whenever you defend with Stalagmite, create a Frostbite token under the attacking hero's control.
Temper

staunch_response.text_zh: 使用坚毅回应的额外费用是：你可以支付4点资源。若如此做，坚毅回应获得+3防御。
staunch_response.text_en: As an additional cost to play Staunch Response you may pay {r}{r}{r}{r}. If you do, Staunch Response gains +3{d}.

tear_asunder.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次守护者攻击获得+1力量、支配，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄弃两张牌。”
再动
tear_asunder.text_en:
Your next Guardian attack this turn gains +1{p}, dominate, and "When this hits a hero, they discard 2 cards."
Go again

titans_fist.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击。
如果你的资源区有一张费用为3或更高的牌，泰坦之拳获得+1力量。
titans_fist.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack
If there is a card with cost 3 or greater in your pitch zone, Titan's Fist has +1{p}.
